authorized_scope: Replace Itsumi with Rumi in stage B using updated source; retain implemented Serika Lv2 gates, schedule and nine approved CGs.

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【七濑恋戴着手术帽与系带口罩，正在台旁检查器械。年轻的巡回护士薗田爱实已在一旁核对设备、整理备好的用品。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【七濑恋戴着手术帽与系带口罩，正在台旁检查器械。巡回护士正在另一侧熟练地核对监护设备、整理备好的用品。】

changes.english: 【Ren Nanase, wearing a surgical cap and a tied surgical mask, was checking instruments beside the table. On the other side, the circulating nurse was efficiently checking the monitors and organizing the prepared supplies.】

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实从记录板上抬起头，露出元气十足的眼神。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士合上记录板，接话的速度比七濑恋快了半拍。口罩上方的眼睛透出一点笑意。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse closed her clipboard and chimed in half a beat ahead of Ren. There was a hint of amusement in her eyes above the mask.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「今天准备单全部合格哦！连重新整理的东西都不多，病房那边做得很漂亮。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「准备单全打勾了。病房那边做得漂亮，今天开局不错嘛。」

changes.english: 「Every box on the checklist is ticked. The ward team did a great job. We're off to a good start today.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「当然值得夸！不过先上台吧，麻醉和导尿都还没做呢。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「我夸呀！千早小姐真能忍。不过奖状先欠着，麻醉和导尿都还没做呢。」

changes.english: 「I'm praising you! You held up well, Miss Chihaya. But the certificate can wait—we haven't done the anesthesia or catheter yet.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「因为手术还没开始呀。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「因为……手术本身还没开始嘛。」

changes.english: 「Because... the operation itself hasn't started yet.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实拿起腕带，正要进行最后一次核对。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士伸手去核对千早的腕带。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse reached out to check Chihaya's wristband.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「仓本千早小姐，手先给我。出生日期是——」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「仓本千早小姐，手给我，我们最后核对一次生日——」

changes.english: 「Miss Chihaya Kuramoto, give me your hand. Let's check your date of birth one last time—」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「啊！千早小姐！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「哎！千早小姐？！」

changes.english: 「Hey! Miss Chihaya?!」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「等等！走廊地板才清洁过，小心滑倒——！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「等等！别跑那么快——地刚擦过，会滑的！」

changes.english: 「Wait! Don't run so fast—the floor was just mopped. It's slippery!」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【七濑恋和爱实终于追来。见坂口已经拦住千早，两人很有默契地分站两侧。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【七濑恋和巡回护士终于追来。见坂口已经拦住千早，两人很有默契地分站两侧。】

changes.english: 【Ren and the circulating nurse finally caught up. Seeing that Sakaguchi had already stopped Chihaya, they instinctively took positions on either side of her.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「抓到了！太好了！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「坂口医生，干得漂亮！」

changes.english: 「Nice work, Dr. Sakaguchi!」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「我们也是第一次遇见跑两次的呀！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「同一个人跑第二次，我们也没见过呀！千早小姐，你真会给大家出难题。」

changes.english: 「We've never had the same person run away twice either! Miss Chihaya, you really do keep us on our toes.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【坂口领着她转身，七濑恋和爱实一左一右跟紧，三人直接把赤身赤脚的千早带回手术室。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【坂口领着她转身，七濑恋和巡回护士一左一右跟紧，三人直接把赤身赤脚的千早带回手术室。】

changes.english: 【Sakaguchi turned her around and led the way. Ren and the circulating nurse stayed close on either side, and the three of them took the naked, barefoot Chihaya straight back into the operating room.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「太好了，导尿包还没打开呢，不用重新准备一套。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「还好导尿包没拆封，省得回去重新开一套。你跑得真会挑时间。」

changes.english: 「Good thing we hadn't opened the catheter kit. Now we don't have to open a fresh one when we get back. You picked quite a moment to run.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实走到手术台旁。她的工作服、口罩和手术帽穿戴得整整齐齐，手中拿着准备单，眼神明亮得与床上的千早形成鲜明对比。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士走到手术台旁。她的刷手服、口罩和手术帽穿戴整齐，一只手夹着准备单。她说话爽快，视线却始终留意千早的反应。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse came to the operating table. Her scrubs, mask and cap were neatly in place, and she held a checklist in one hand. She spoke briskly while keeping a close eye on Chihaya's reactions.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「好，接下来由我负责。麻醉已经完成，后面会很快的！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「好，下面由我接手。麻醉做完了，后面会很快的——这次我说真的。」

changes.english: 「All right, I'll take over from here. The anesthesia's done, so the rest will be quick—and I mean it this time.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「先导尿，再调整手臂位置，固定安全带，消毒，最后铺巾。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「顺序先告诉你：导尿、调整手臂、固定安全带、消毒，最后铺巾。一项一项来。」

changes.english: 「Here's the order: catheter, arm positioning, safety straps, skin prep, and finally draping. One thing at a time.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「漏说了你不是更会吓一跳吗？」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「那等会儿冷不防碰你一下，你不是更容易跳起来？」

changes.english: 「Wouldn't you jump even more if I touched you without warning?」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实确认导尿用品与麻醉情况。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士确认导尿用品与麻醉情况。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse checked the catheter supplies and the anesthesia status.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「这台手术在盆腔操作，膀胱排空很重要。我们现在给你放导尿管。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「这台要在盆腔操作，膀胱必须排空。所以第一项，给你放导尿管。」

changes.english: 「We'll be operating in the pelvis, so your bladder has to be empty. First item: inserting a urinary catheter.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「当然可以呀。闭上眼睛就好，我会告诉你重要的事情。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「行啊，你闭眼，我来做。需要你配合的时候，我还是会提醒你的。」

changes.english: 「Sure. You close your eyes, and I'll handle it. I'll still let you know when I need you to cooperate.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「会有人不好意思。不过我们每天都做，手法很熟练，你不用担心。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「当然会不好意思啊。我们每天都做这件事，所以手法很熟，尽量让你少受折腾。」

changes.english: 「Of course it's embarrassing. We do this every day, so we're practiced at it. We'll try to put you through as little trouble as possible.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实按无菌规范完成导尿并妥善固定导管，注意不让管路受压。千早盯着天花板，脸从红变成一副无可奈何的表情。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士按无菌规范完成导尿并妥善固定导管，注意不让管路受压。千早盯着天花板，脸从红变成一副无可奈何的表情。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse inserted the urinary catheter using sterile technique and secured it carefully, making sure the tubing was not compressed. Chihaya stared at the ceiling, her flushed expression turning into one of resignation.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「嗯嗯，很顺利呢！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「好了。你配合得挺好嘛。」

changes.english: 「There we go. You cooperated really well.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「呵呵呵，其实直接导尿也还好啦，就是会有一点刺痛！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「不麻醉的话可能会有点刺痛。你看，今天这一项已经算轻松过关了。」

changes.english: 「Without anesthesia, it might sting a little. See? This part was an easy one today.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「好了。接下来手臂伸开一点。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「下一项。来，两只手臂往外一点。」

changes.english: 「Next item. Come on, move both arms out a little.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实调整两侧上肢的位置，检查受压点，扣好防止术中滑动的安全带。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士调整两侧上肢的位置，检查受压点，扣好防止术中滑动的安全带。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse adjusted both upper limbs, checked pressure points and fastened the safety straps to prevent slipping during surgery.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「是安全固定。手术时不能让手臂突然掉下去，也不能让你无意识坐起来。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「叫安全固定。手术时手臂不能突然滑下去，你也不能冷不防坐起来吓大家一跳。」

changes.english: 「It's called safety positioning. Your arms can't suddenly slip off during surgery, and you can't sit up out of nowhere and give us all a fright.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「现在你都麻醉了，哪里还跑得动呀。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「你现在麻醉都打好了，还打算怎么跑？我可不想再追第三趟啦。」

changes.english: 「You've already had the anesthesia. How are you planning to run now? I don't want to chase you a third time!」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实拿起皮肤消毒用品，确认下腹部旧切口位置和既定术野范围。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士拿起皮肤消毒用品，确认下腹部旧切口位置和既定术野范围。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse picked up the skin-preparation supplies and checked the old lower abdominal incision and the planned operative field.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「下腹部要大范围消毒。会有点凉，请尽量不要扭动。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「接下来消毒下腹部。会凉，先跟你说好——别扭着腰躲哦。」

changes.english: 「Next, skin prep on your lower abdomen. It'll be cold—I'm warning you now, so don't twist away.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「忍一下。这次切口准备范围比想象中规整，处理起来很方便。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「忍一忍，马上好。今天切口准备的范围很清楚，处理起来倒是很顺手。」

changes.english: 「Bear with me. Almost done. Today's incision-preparation area is clearly defined, which makes this part go smoothly.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「因为工作确实很顺利呀。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「做得顺，我当然高兴。你这一台呀，除了刚才跑出去那段，其他都很顺利。」

changes.english: 「Of course I'm happy when the work goes smoothly. Apart from your little run just now, everything with you has gone very well.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实认真核对消毒范围和皮肤情况，又退后一步检查两侧安全带与管路。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士认真核对消毒范围和皮肤情况，又退后一步检查两侧安全带与管路。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse carefully checked the prepared skin and its boundaries, then stepped back to recheck both safety straps and the tubing.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「好！导尿完成，体位固定完成，皮肤消毒完成。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「核对一下：导尿完成，体位固定完成，皮肤消毒完成。全部确认。」

changes.english: 「Checklist: catheter in place, positioning secured, skin prep complete. All confirmed.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「对我们来说，准备做得漂亮，主刀医生就可以安心开刀了。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「对我们很重要啊。准备得漂亮，主刀医生才能放心开刀。这就是我的工作嘛。」

changes.english: 「It's important to us. When the preparation's done well, the surgeon can start with confidence. That's my job.」

before.speaker: 阿库娅
before.text: 「准备得不错嘛。爱实，辛苦啦。」

after.speaker: 阿库娅
after.text: 「准备得不错嘛。留美，辛苦啦。」

changes.english: 「Nicely prepared. Thanks, Rumi.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「都完成了。患者状态稳定，导管和固定也确认过。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「都完成了。患者状态稳定，导管和固定也核对过。」

changes.english: 「All done. The patient's stable, and I've checked the catheter and restraints too.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实从非无菌侧协助递送无菌铺巾用品，七濑恋与已刷手的手术团队按规范依次展开手术单。下腹只留下预定切口所在的手术窗口，其余区域由无菌单覆盖。千早只要抬眼，就能看见阿库娅和坂口戴着口罩低头准备手术，也能看见他们与七濑恋交接器械。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士从非无菌侧协助递送无菌铺巾用品，七濑恋与已刷手的手术团队按规范依次展开手术单。下腹只留下预定切口所在的手术窗口，其余区域由无菌单覆盖。千早只要抬眼，就能看见阿库娅和坂口戴着口罩低头准备手术，也能看见他们与七濑恋交接器械。】

changes.english: 【From the nonsterile side, the circulating nurse helped pass the sterile draping supplies. Ren and the scrubbed surgical team unfolded the drapes in sequence. Only the planned lower abdominal incision site remained exposed through the opening; the rest was covered by sterile drapes. By simply looking up, Chihaya could see the masked Aqua and Sakaguchi leaning down to prepare, as well as their instrument exchanges with Ren.】

before.speaker: 坂口
before.text: 「……爱实，继续监测。」

after.speaker: 坂口
after.text: 「……留美，继续监测。」

changes.english: 「...Rumi, keep monitoring.」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「明白。」

changes.english: 「Understood.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【无影灯移到术野正上方。爱实在头侧检查监护与管路；阿库娅站到主刀位，坂口就位于助手侧，七濑恋准备器械。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【无影灯移到术野正上方。巡回护士在头侧检查监护与管路；阿库娅站到主刀位，坂口就位于助手侧，七濑恋准备器械。】

changes.english: 【The surgical light moved directly over the operative field. The circulating nurse checked the monitors and tubing at the head end; Aqua took the surgeon's position, Sakaguchi stood on the assistant's side, and Ren readied the instruments.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「身份、腕带、过敏信息、导尿与固定确认。生命体征稳定。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「身份和腕带一致。过敏信息、导尿与固定都已确认。生命体征稳定。」

changes.english: 「Identity matches the wristband. Allergies, catheter and positioning all checked. Vital signs stable.」

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「千早小姐，哪里不舒服？」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「千早小姐，哪里难受？告诉我。」

changes.english: 「Miss Chihaya, what's bothering you? Tell me.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【爱实迅速核对监测数据。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【巡回护士迅速核对监测数据。】

changes.english: 【The circulating nurse quickly checked the monitoring data.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「血压稍微降了一点。坂口医生，患者说有明显牵拉不适。」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「血压稍微降了一点。坂口医生，千早小姐说有明显牵拉不适。」

changes.english: 「Blood pressure is down a little. Dr. Sakaguchi, Miss Chihaya reports significant discomfort from the traction.」

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【牵拉立即停止。爱实按已确认的围术期方案处理并继续观察，坂口确认千早没有出现锐痛或其他危险症状。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【牵拉立即停止。巡回护士按已确认的围术期方案处理并继续观察，坂口确认千早没有出现锐痛或其他危险症状。】

changes.english: 【Traction stopped immediately. The circulating nurse followed the agreed perioperative plan and continued observing, while Sakaguchi confirmed that Chihaya had no sharp pain or other danger signs.】

before.speaker: 旁白
before.text: 【坂口协助逐层缝合腹壁。阿库娅检查针线位置，七濑恋准确交接器械，爱实持续核对监测和术中记录。】

after.speaker: 旁白
after.text: 【坂口协助逐层缝合腹壁。阿库娅检查针线位置，七濑恋准确交接器械，巡回护士持续核对监测和术中记录。】

changes.english: 【Sakaguchi assisted with closing the abdominal wall in layers. Aqua checked the sutures, Ren passed instruments precisely, and the circulating nurse continued checking the monitoring and intraoperative records.】

before.speaker: 薗田爱实
before.text: 「今天也辛苦啦！千早小姐，你已经是第二次通关了呢！」

after.speaker: 岩崎留美
after.text: 「辛苦啦，千早小姐！恭喜第二关通关——就是中途逃跑那段，得扣一点分。」

changes.english: 「Well done, Miss Chihaya! Congratulations on clearing stage two—though we'll have to deduct a few points for that escape in the middle.」
